issue.title: test_cancel_saves_once_submit_path_quiet fails under full just check with FrontmatterPanel NoMatches
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1g4.1.1.4 note #2 during surface verification of epic sase-1g4.1.1.

just check ToolRun d1031947d02a0922a64213d8bde089ef failed this node under the 14-worker lane. FrontmatterPanel.on_mount raised textual.css.query.NoMatches('#frontmatter-raw') on FrontmatterPanel(id=frontmatter-panel, classes=hidden). An immediate isolation pytest of the same node on that tree passed (3.64s call). Fail rate was not measured beyond that one full-lane failure and one isolation pass. The surface diff did not edit frontmatter_panel.py.

Same missing-widget class as ready tasks sase-1fy and sase-1g5, and closed sase-pe, but a different pytest node. Those beads stay node-specific. Open epic sase-j7 already has DISCOVERED ISSUE note #85 for this node; the symptom is a Textual compose race, not a confirmed process-global leak, so this stays a node-specific flake rather than more sase-j7 scope.
